vulns.title: Auction settle sweeps the whole balance to the seller, stranding outbid bidders' refunds
vulns.root_cause: settle transfers the ENTIRE `auction.balance` to the seller instead of only the winning bid (`highest_bid`). But `auction.balance` also holds outbid bidders' refundable deposits: when a higher bid arrives, `bid` hands the previous highest bidder a BidReceipt refundable for their amount and leaves that amount in the balance. Because settle sweeps everything to the seller, an outbid bidder's later `claim_refund` aborts against an empty balance — their deposit is stolen. Concretely, a colluding seller shill-bids one unit over a victim to outbid them, then settles: the seller receives the victim's deposit on top of their own returned shill bid, netting exactly the victim's stranded deposit. The fix pays the seller only `highest_bid` and leaves outbid deposits in the balance so `claim_refund` can still honor them (settle and refunds no longer draw against the same funds).
